# PrivateVoting

> PrivateVoting is a secure, auditable Private Online Voting platform providing Free Voting, School Voting, College Voting, and Live Voting for schools, educational institutions, housing societies, non-profits, and enterprises across India and worldwide.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.privatevoting.in/): Official homepage for Private Voting, School Voting, College Voting, and Live Online Voting.
- [Features](https://www.privatevoting.in/features): Election setup, candidate management, voter verification, live monitoring, and automated result generation.
- [Pricing](https://www.privatevoting.in/pricing): Flexible pricing tiers, free trial voting credits, and institutional packages.
- [Security](https://www.privatevoting.in/security): End-to-end ballot confidentiality, encrypted counting, IP restrictions, and audit logs.
- [FAQ](https://www.privatevoting.in/faq): Frequently asked questions about voter authentication, multi-ballot elections, and result certification.
- [Contact & Demo](https://www.privatevoting.in/contact): Contact support, book an election demo, or plan an organization rollout.
- [About Us](https://www.privatevoting.in/about-us): About PrivateVoting, election governance standards, and company information.

## Use Cases

- [School & College Elections](https://www.privatevoting.in/features): Digital voting for School Principals, Coordinators, Head Boy/Head Girl, and student council elections.
- [Housing Societies & RWAs](https://www.privatevoting.in/features): Controlled elections for Society Chairmen, Secretaries, and AGM committee votes.
- [Corporate & Organization Voting](https://www.privatevoting.in/features): Board of Directors, committee resolutions, and member elections.

## Legal & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.privatevoting.in/privacy-policy): Voter privacy, ballot anonymization, and data security policies.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.privatevoting.in/terms-of-service): Terms and acceptable use policies for election administrators.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.privatevoting.in/cookie-policy): Session handling and cookie management policies.
